title: Record Pi health-check terminal-versus-hcom result
description: Record the operator-authorized minimal health check against fresh visible Pi vema using qwen2.5-coder:7b-16k. The model displayed the exact acknowledgement in its terminal, but hcom emitted no outbound message event. Preserve the distinction and keep Pi excluded from coordination.
acceptance_criteria: Durable evidence records the visible model response and the absence of an hcom message event as a communication-check failure.
No Pi task, review, handoff, release, routing, or capacity authority is added.
